market.question: Will the highest temperature in Houston be between 82-83°F on May 9?

assessment.reasoning: Houston May 9 forecast (Space City Weather May 6 update): mostly sunny with highs in low-to-mid 80s. The 82-83°F bin covers about 30-40% of the likely high range. With Hobby Airport potentially slightly cooler than central Houston due to bay proximity, 82-83°F is plausible but not the central case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Two-degree bin is narrow; forecast typically has ±2-3°F uncertainty even one day out.
